name: Bayesian sparse linear mixed model
model_likelihood: Quantitative phenotype regression with sparse marker effects and a polygenic random effect; for K=XX^T/p, y=1 mu+X beta_tilde+X alpha+epsilon with Gaussian residuals.
prior: Point-normal sparse effects plus Gaussian background effects; independent uniform h and rho hyperpriors targeting approximately uniform PVE/PGE priors; limiting conjugate mean/precision priors.
inference_algorithm: Collapsed Metropolis-Hastings for h, rho, pi and gamma; analytic integration of beta_tilde, u and tau; eigendecomposition of K accelerates likelihood evaluation.
estimand: Posterior means and standard deviations of PVE and PGE.
data_input: Individual-level quantitative phenotypes and genotype matrix; genotypes coded 0/1/2, centered without standardization; known relatedness K.
tunable_settings: Maximum active SNP count (300 in simulations/human data; 600 in mouse data); MCMC iterations and burn-in; hyperparameters are inferred rather than fixed modeling assumptions.
